primary_question: Can a homogeneous numerical neural circuit choose and write previously unknown association identities into initially blank synaptic slots by its own activity, instead of choosing from pre-enumerated task representations or using Python to choose addresses, labels or slots?
scope_of_claim: This constructs new *instances* of learned representations, NOT previously unsupported computational primitive types. It is a small bounded neural associative memory, not general intelligence or arbitrary causal-operator discovery.
input: Four binary sensory bits x0..x3, one binary observed action-consequence label y, a constant 1. For three-bit tasks, x3=0. Host only validates and forwards bits, with no state-to-class mapping, pattern lookup or slot-selection branch.

neural_architecture.fixed: 16 IDENTICAL initially blank slots. Each has an experience-written used weight, four experience-written address weights and one experience-written reward weight. A fixed numeric threshold-neuron graph computes address equality and a first-free-slot winner, selects a plastic memory slot, detects repeats and contradictions, and emits reward and covered/confidence. No per-input identity detector weights or per-task hypothesis weights preloaded.
neural_architecture.plastic: 16*(used1+address4+label1)+fault1 = 97 writable binary synaptic coefficients, all initialized 0. No label/class function enumerated in fixed synapses.
neural_architecture.plastic_update: One homogeneous local three-factor synaptic write w<-OR(w,activity[pre]*activity[post]*activity[mod]) applied simultaneously AFTER forward inference. Used, address, label and fault weights are allocated by precompiled numeric eligibility gates, not by task-specific Python branching.
neural_architecture.runtime: One homogeneous weighted-sum/threshold neuron kernel and one generic synaptic OR learning kernel. No dictionary, symbolic lookup, explicit context-address allocation in Python, adaptive opcode dispatch, gradient optimizer or external function evaluator in the model. Python builder compiles the prior fixed equality/first-free rule once; the generic Python neuron VM remains external.
neural_architecture.limits: 16 slots, four input dimensions, 97 plastic weights, <=3 fixed-coefficient slots reused, <=512 total threshold nodes, <=1600 directed synaptic incidence edges, snapshot canonical with program hash/weights SHA-256.

frozen_data.three_bit: ALL 256 possible Boolean truth tables on three input bits, integer mask 0..255. For each mask, eight distinct patterns in order random.Random(0xC0FFEE + mask*131 + 3*1000003).shuffle([0..7]); reveal label=(mask>>pattern)&1 at each real observation. x3 padded 0.
frozen_data.four_bit: 72 distinct four-input Boolean truth tables: the eight fixed masks [0x0000,0xffff,0x6996,0x9669,0xaaaa,0x5555,0xcccc,0x3333] and 64 unique masks from SHA256('WSP09-mask|seed='+decimal_seed) first 2 bytes interpreted little-endian, scanning increasing seed, skipping duplicates and fixed masks. Pattern order random.Random(0xC0FFEE+mask*131+4*1000003).shuffle([0..15]).
frozen_data.queries: Before EACH first occurrence of a pattern, require abstention (3200/3200), then after genuine witness immediately require correct label (3200/3200). After all observations, 3200/3200 recalled correct labels. No unused pattern is scored as transfer or novel-world generalization.
frozen_data.baselines: Independent exact symbolic associative map with the identical 3200 public observations, required parity. Gradient-trained logistic one-hot 16-feature, 16-parameter conventional neural output layer on eight predefined four-input tables (the eight fixed masks). Full batch Adam seed17, learning rate0.05, stop BCE<=0.02, max3000 epochs; all sixteen observations per table supplied. 8*16=128 conventional covered predictions; if not converged, mark qualified-trained baseline UNVERIFIED.
frozen_data.negative: Each learned world receives exactly one previously seen pattern with inverted label after final scoring. Numeric contradiction latch must become 1 and ALL outputs subsequently abstain, no false inference of the shifted function. The two histories prior to contradictory observation are identical. No recovery unless new independent evidence supplied. A fifth input dimension must be rejected.
frozen_data.ablation: Zero used synapses after learning -> all patterns abstain; zero one label synapse must change at least one known positive prediction (on a positive-containing table); zero address synapses must destroy discriminating mapping. Cold exact weights, four old-event replays, separate-world isolation.
frozen_data.information_limit: For arbitrary Boolean functions with independent unknown labels, no learner can predict any unobserved bit with guaranteed correctness without prior rule information. Complete coverage of n=4 requires 16 label bits worst case. This gate cannot demonstrate sample-efficiency gain and MUST state it explicitly.
frozen_data.engineering_pass: All 328 tables with all 3200 pre-observation abstentions, immediate post-witness label correctness and full replay; 328 exact cold restores, 328 four-event idempotent replays, learned numeric weights and fault guard, eight conventional trained controls convergence disclosed, full original + WSP01..09 dual-platform exact-source regression, source atlas and clean checkout.
frozen_data.scientific_pass: NOT CLAIMED by public author-visible DEV. Even perfect implementation establishes generic weight-coded association allocation, NOT new neural primitive type generation, general cognition, causal transfer to independently unfamiliar dynamics, or compute/data superiority.
frozen_data.invalid: Do not alter masks, seeds, outcome rule, training budgets, source assumption, controls or scoring after first DEV run. Engineering bug fixes must be disclosed and entire final exact-SHA regression rerun.
